label: MUTHUR -> InfluxDB
info:
Bridges the MUTHUR MQTT tree into InfluxDB.

Topic shape: MUTHUR/<class>/<node>/<metric>
Measurement = node, field = metric, tags = group/class/node.

See NodeRED/README.md in the RhizoMon repo.

name: 1. Set the broker + InfluxDB credentials after importing
info: Node-RED never exports passwords or tokens. Open the MQTT and InfluxDB config nodes and fill them in.
